metadata.question: Did the water in Lake Bosumtwi appear more green in December 2024 than in December 2015?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Location: Lake Bosumtwi, Ghana. Define a point and buffer (~7 km) to cover the lake.
- Collections: Prefer Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level 2 Surface Reflectance for both 2015 and 2024. If a year-month has zero images, expand window by ±15 days. If still zero, fallback to Sentinel-2 L1C with cloud masking.
- Dates: December 2015 vs December 2024.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask clouds/shadows/snow using QA bits (Landsat) and QA60 (Sentinel-2).
- Restrict to lake water via JRC Global Surface Water occurrence > 90% and NDWI > 0 on the composite.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check collection sizes; if zero after fallback -> C1.
- Compute valid pixel counts; if zero valid pixels with images present -> C2.
- Validate mean ratio result: not null, finite, and within plausible range (0 < ratio < 3). Otherwise -> C3.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const center = ee.Geometry.Point([-1.406, 6.496]); // Lake Bosumtwi approximate center
    const roi = center.buffer(7000); // ~7 km to cover the lake
    const occ = ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater').select('occurrence');
    const staticWaterMask = occ.gt(90).clip(roi).selfMask(); // Persistent water within ROI

    // Utility: format date
    const fmt = (d) => ee.Date(d).format('YYYY-MM-dd');

    // Cloud masking and scaling
    function maskLandsatL2SR(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1).eq(0) // not fill
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0)) // not dilated cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0)) // not cirrus
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0)) // not cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)) // not cloud shadow
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0)); // not snow
      const scaled = img.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B5'], ['blue','green','nir'])
        .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
      return scaled.updateMask(mask);
    }
    function maskS2L1C(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA60');
      const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).neq(0).or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).neq(0));
      const scaled = img.select(['B2','B3','B8'], ['blue','green','nir']).multiply(1e-4);
      return scaled.updateMask(cloud.not());
    }

    // Get composite for a given year and December, with fallback
    function getComposite(year) {
      const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 12, 1);
      const end = start.advance(1, 'month');
      const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end);
      const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end);
      let col = l8.merge(l9).map(maskLandsatL2SR);
      let size = col.size();
      let used = ee.String('Landsat (Dec)');
      let sUsed = start; let eUsed = end;

      // Fallback 1: expand window ±15 days
      col = ee.ImageCollection(ee.Algorithms.If(
        size.gt(0),
        col,
        l8.filterDate(start.advance(-15, 'day'), end.advance(15, 'day'))
          .merge(l9.filterDate(start.advance(-15, 'day'), end.advance(15, 'day')))
          .map(maskLandsatL2SR)
      ));
      size = col.size();
      used = ee.String(ee.Algorithms.If(size.gt(0), 'Landsat (±15d)', used));
      sUsed = ee.Date(ee.Algorithms.If(size.gt(0), start.advance(-15, 'day'), sUsed));
      eUsed = ee.Date(ee.Algorithms.If(size.gt(0), end.advance(15, 'day'), eUsed));

      // Fallback 2: Sentinel-2 L1C if still empty
      const s2col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2')
        .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(sUsed, eUsed)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80))
        .map(maskS2L1C);
      col = ee.ImageCollection(ee.Algorithms.If(
        size.gt(0),
        col,
        s2col
      ));
      size = col.size();
      used = ee.String(ee.Algorithms.If(size.gt(0).and(used.compareTo('Landsat (±15d)').neq(0)),
        'Sentinel-2 L1C', used));

      return ee.Dictionary({
        collection: col,
        size: size,
        start: sUsed,
        end: eUsed,
        used: used
      });
    }

    function computeStats(year) {
      const info = getComposite(year);
      const size = ee.Number(info.get('size'));
      const used = ee.String(info.get('used'));
      const sUsed = ee.Date(info.get('start'));
      const eUsed = ee.Date(info.get('end'));
      const col = ee.ImageCollection(info.get('collection'));

      const empty = size.lte(0);
      const composite = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If(empty, ee.Image(), col.median().clip(roi)));

      // Water mask: static persistent water AND NDWI > 0
      const ndwi = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If(empty, ee.Image(), composite.expression(
        '(g - nir) / (g + nir)', {g: composite.select('green'), nir: composite.select('nir')}
      ))).rename('ndwi');
      const waterMask = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If(
        empty, ee.Image(0),
        staticWaterMask.updateMask(staticWaterMask).updateMask(ndwi.gt(0))
      ));

      const ratio = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If(empty, ee.Image(), composite.select('green').divide(composite.select('blue'))))
        .rename('gbr').updateMask(waterMask);

      // Total static water pixels (~1 km) and valid pixels
      const total = ee.Number(
        ee.Image(1).updateMask(staticWaterMask)
          .reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry: roi,
            scale: 1000,
            maxPixels: 1e9
          }).get('constant')
      );
      const valid = ee.Number(
        ratio.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('gbr')
      );

      const mean = ee.Number(
        ratio.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('gbr')
      );

      const validPct = ee.Number(100).multiply(valid.divide(total));
      const cloudPct = ee.Number(100).subtract(validPct);

      return ee.Dictionary({
        year: year,
        used: used,
        window: fmt(sUsed).cat(' to ').cat(fmt(eUsed)),
        images: size,
        total: total,
        valid: valid,
        validPct: validPct,
        cloudPct: cloudPct,
        mean: mean
      });
    }

    // Precompute total static water pixels once for reporting
    const totalStatic = await ee.Number(
      ee.Image(1).updateMask(staticWaterMask).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('constant')
    ).getInfo();

    console.log(`ROI: Lake Bosumtwi (~7km buffer). Static water px (~1km): ${totalStatic}`);

    // 2015 and 2024 stats
    const d2015 = await computeStats(2015).getInfo();
    const d2024 = await computeStats(2024).getInfo();

    // Case handling: empty collections
    if (d2015.images <= 0 || d2024.images <= 0) {
      console.log(`2015 Images: ${d2015.images} [${d2015.used}] (window ${d2015.window})`);
      console.log(`2024 Images: ${d2024.images} [${d2024.used}] (window ${d2024.window})`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Case handling: no valid pixels after masking
    if ((d2015.valid || 0) === 0 || (d2024.valid || 0) === 0) {
      console.log(`2015 Images: ${d2015.images} [${d2015.used}] (window ${d2015.window})`);
      console.log(`2015 Valid: ${d2015.valid}/${d2015.total} (~${(d2015.validPct||0).toFixed(1)}%), Cloud ~${(d2015.cloudPct||0).toFixed(1)}%`);
      console.log(`2024 Images: ${d2024.images} [${d2024.used}] (window ${d2024.window})`);
      console.log(`2024 Valid: ${d2024.valid}/${d2024.total} (~${(d2024.validPct||0).toFixed(1)}%), Cloud ~${(d2024.cloudPct||0).toFixed(1)}%`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Validate means
    function isInvalid(val) {
      return val === null || !isFinite(val) || val <= 0 || val >= 3;
    }
    const m2015 = d2015.mean;
    const m2024 = d2024.mean;
    if (isInvalid(m2015) || isInvalid(m2024)) {
      console.log(`2015 Mean G/B: ${m2015}, 2024 Mean G/B: ${m2024}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Evidence prints
    console.log(`2015 Images: ${d2015.images} [${d2015.used}] (window ${d2015.window})`);
    console.log(`2015 Valid: ${d2015.valid}/${d2015.total} (~${d2015.validPct.toFixed(1)}%), Cloud ~${d2015.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}%`);
    console.log(`2015 Mean Green/Blue: ${m2015.toFixed(3)}`);

    console.log(`2024 Images: ${d2024.images} [${d2024.used}] (window ${d2024.window})`);
    console.log(`2024 Valid: ${d2024.valid}/${d2024.total} (~${d2024.validPct.toFixed(1)}%), Cloud ~${d2024.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}%`);
    console.log(`2024 Mean Green/Blue: ${m2024.toFixed(3)}`);

    // Final Answer: Was water more green in Dec 2024 than in Dec 2015?
    const moreGreen = m2024 > m2015;
    console.log(moreGreen ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    // If any error occurs (bad band name, memory, etc.)
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
